title: questing-devel → ubuntu/questing-devel
diff:
diff --git a/debian/changelog b/debian/changelog
index 7d73741..2cb81c2 100644
--- a/debian/changelog
+++ b/debian/changelog
@@ -1,3 +1,13 @@
+open-iscsi (2.1.11-1ubuntu3.1) questing; urgency=medium
+
+  * d/extra/initramfs/local-top/iscsi: normalize static bootproto for
+    initramfs netplan conversion. In iscsi_auto flow, firmware reports
+    bootproto as STATIC, but netinfo_to_netplan handles static IPv4
+    through PROTO=none with address fields. Map STATIC to PROTO=none
+    and record IPV4PROTO=static in net-*.conf. (LP: #2147499)
+
+ -- Zhang Hua <joshua.zhang@canonical.com>  Fri, 03 Jul 2026 16:39:10 +0800
+
 open-iscsi (2.1.11-1ubuntu3) questing; urgency=medium
 
   * d/t/patch-image: Ignore binaries with Architecture: amd64 of
diff --git a/debian/extra/initramfs/local-top/iscsi b/debian/extra/initramfs/local-top/iscsi
index d294da9..4de4de2 100755
--- a/debian/extra/initramfs/local-top/iscsi
+++ b/debian/extra/initramfs/local-top/iscsi
@@ -108,6 +108,7 @@ do_iscsi_login ()
 			("# BEGIN RECORD"*)
 				DEVICE=""
 				PROTO="none"
+				IPV4PROTO=""
 				IPV4ADDR=""
 				IPV4NETMASK=""
 				IPV4GATEWAY=""
@@ -123,6 +124,7 @@ do_iscsi_login ()
 				{
 					echo "DEVICE='${DEVICE}'"
 					echo "PROTO='${PROTO}'"
+					echo "IPV4PROTO='${IPV4PROTO}'"
 					echo "IPV4ADDR='${IPV4ADDR}'"
 					echo "IPV4BROADCAST=''"
 					echo "IPV4NETMASK='${IPV4NETMASK}'"
@@ -168,9 +170,20 @@ do_iscsi_login ()
 				iface.net_ifacename) DEVICE="${v}" ;;
 				iface.bootproto)
 					case "${v}" in
-						DHCP)	PROTO="dhcp"   ;;
-						STATIC)	PROTO="static" ;;
-						*)	PROTO="${v}"   ;;
+						DHCP)
+							PROTO="dhcp"
+							IPV4PROTO="dhcp"
+							;;
+						STATIC)
+							# netinfo_to_netplan handles static IPv4 via PROTO=none + address fields.
+							# Keep IPV4PROTO=static for consumers that parse /run/network/dynamic-interfaces.
+							PROTO="none"
+							IPV4PROTO="static"
+							;;
+						*)
+							PROTO="${v}"
+							IPV4PROTO="${v}"
+							;;
 					esac
 					;;
 			esac
